definitions.partA: active=>=5 distinct order dates & last order<=18mo; decelerating=days_since>own p90 gap; dormant(>365d) excluded; warm<=30d email, cooling 31-90d, silent>90d/none
definitions.partB: accept window=date_accepted-date_created over won base-quote_no/version-stripped (>=5 won windows else global fallback); open=no job on any revision, created<=18mo; listed if days_open>max(own p75,14d); follow-up=outbound email to contact (fallback company) in (created,+14d]
caveats: qb_quotes has NO declined/expired status — 'open' is inferred; some may be silently dead
QB accept windows degenerate (median ~0d: date_accepted ~ date_created on most wins) — the 14d floor is doing most of the work; treat as open-quote book past 2wk, not measured decision windows
AM for Part A = mode(am_customer) over operations; Part B = quote_am_name
